description.narrative: The Project will provide improved urban wastewater services in the cities of Cimahi, Jambi, Makassar, Palembang, and Pekanbaru in the Republic of Indonesia. These cities currently lack any piped sewerage and wastewater treatment facilities. The Project will respond to the needs of urban communities, including low-income households, by constructing new separate sewerage systems and wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs), setting up local wastewater infrastructure management institutions and strengthening the relevant departments of respective regional governments.

description.narrative: Increased connection of the population to improved wastewater services in the participating cities.

121,000 households (605,000 persons) not connected to the sewerage systems will be served through regular desludging system. Achievement: 818227 Progress/Status: Achieved. A total of 818,227 households (HHs) are served through desludging service with the following detail:
(i) in Jambi, 183,616 HHs, (ii) in Makassar, 388,772 HHs (iii) in Pekanbaru, 245,839 HHs.
The city governments are in the process of updating the data through the latest environmental health risk assessment study and city sanitation strategy/master plan for the wastewater treatment system. The result of this study and assessment will provide information of number of households in project city who are not connected to sewerage network but are served through regular desludging. Data Source: Project Performance Monitoring System, (PPMS), including sex disaggregated indicators and indicators for connection of poor and vulnerable groups such as women-headed households by the Project Executing Agency.

130,500 persons and 6,200 business identified and have access to be connected to sewerage and wastewater systems in Jambi, Pekan Baru, and Makassar.(a)
(a) The properties are within the service coverage area where the sewer networks financed by the loan as well as the government's budget are laid. Financing of the property connections (private land/property) will be allocated through each city government's budget and/or other resources and access agreed with each property owner. Achievement: 138928 Progress/Status: Achieved. A total estimate of 138,928 persons and 10,453 business are identified as the potential connections in the sewerage area.
In addition, 1,876 persons and 69 business are already connected to sewerage and wastewater system in MSMIP cities. Data Source: Project Performance Monitoring System, (PPMS), including sex disaggregated indicators and indicators for connection of poor and vulnerable groups such as women-headed households by the Project Executing Agency.

64 community based sanitation systems, added to existing, completed by 2020. Achievement: 1 Progress/Status: Achieved. 293 community-based sanitation system completed. Data Source: Project Performance Monitoring System, (PPMS), including sex disaggregated indicators and indicators for connection of poor and vulnerable groups such as women-headed households by the Project Executing Agency.

By 2025: 26,100 domestic property connections identified and have access to be connected to the central sewerage system.(a) - 9,300 in Jambi - 6,900 in Makassar - 9,900 in Pekan Baru.
(a) The properties are within the service coverage area where the sewer networks financed by the loan as well as the government's budget are laid. Financing of the property connections (private land/property) will be allocated through each city government's budget and/or other resources and access agreed with each property owner. Achievement: 34534 Progress/Status: Achieved. A total of 34,732 potential domestic property connections are identified in the sewer service area, consisting of: - 9,981 in Jambi - 10,101 in Makassar - 14,650 in Pekanbaru.
In addition, 469 domestic property connections are already connected to the central sewerage system: - 388 HHCs in Jambi - 482 HHCs in Makassar - 549 HHCs in Pekanbaru Data Source: Data on sanitation provided by the regional body for planning and development (BAPPEDA) .
National socioeconomic survey statistics (SUSENAS).

By 2025: 6,200 commercial property connections identified and gave access to be connected to the central sewerage system.(a) - 1,000 in Jambi - 4,100 in Makassar - 1,100 in Pekan Baru
(a) The properties are within the service coverage area where the sewer networks financed by the loan as well as the government's budget are laid. Financing of the property connections (private land/property) will be allocated through each city government's budget and/or other resources and access agreed with each property owner. Achievement: 10404 Progress/Status: Achieved. A total of 10,453 potential commercial property connections are identified in the sewer service area, consisting of: - 3,917 in Jambi - 4,980 in Makassar - 1,556 in Pekanbaru.
In addition, 69 commercial property connections are already connected to the central sewerage system: - 28 in Jambi - 25 in Makassar - 16 in Pekanbaru Data Source: Project Performance Monitoring System, (PPMS), including sex disaggregated indicators and indicators for connection of poor and vulnerable groups such as women-headed households by the Project Executing Agency.

By 2025 household connections are fully connected to the central sewerage systems, of which 10% are poor households and households headed by women. Achievement: 469 Progress/Status: Achieved. Of 469 installed HHCs, 64 HHCs are poor households and 34 HHCs are female-headed households (20.90% of total installed HHCs). Data Source: Project Performance Monitoring System, (PPMS), including sex disaggregated indicators and indicators for connection of poor and vulnerable groups such as women-headed households by the Project Executing Agency.
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Project Implementation Support institutionalized. Indicator: By 2022, 10% increase in female staff in management positions in EAs/IAs/ SDOs. Achievement: 44 Progress/Status: Achieved.
Women representation in the management position is 63% in EA, 33% in IA, and 26% in the Unit Pelaksana Teknis Daerah (UPTD). Data Source: Project Performance Monitoring System (PPMS) by the Project Executing Agency.

Output: Infrastructure development for Off-Site Wastewater Systems completed. Indicator: 1a.1. Length of sewer networks laid by 2023: 40.64 km in Jambi Achievement: 27.88 Progress/Status: Achieved. The length of sewer network installed is 43.88 km. Data Source: Data provided by CPMU.
Project Performance Monitoring System (PPMS) by the Project Executing Agency.

Output: Infrastructure development for Off-Site Wastewater Systems completed. Indicator: 1a.2. Length of sewer networks laid by 2023: 66.76 km in Makassar Achievement: 48.79 Progress/Status: Achieved. The length of sewer network installed is 95.79 km. Data Source: Data provided by CPMU.
Project Performance Monitoring System (PPMS) by the Project Executing Agency.

Output: Infrastructure development for Off-Site Wastewater Systems completed. Indicator: 1a.3. Length of sewer networks laid by 2023: 52 km in Pekanbaru Achievement: 10.66 Progress/Status: Substantially achieved. The length of sewer network installed is 51.66 km Data Source: Data provided by CPMU.
Project Performance Monitoring System (PPMS) by the Project Executing Agency.

Output: Infrastructure development for Off-Site Wastewater Systems completed. Indicator: 1b.1. All subproject wastewater treatment works implemented by the end of 2023: 7.6 ML/day in Jambi Achievement: 0.70 Progress/Status: WWTP run at 0.7ML/day. The WWTP is designed to have the full capacity at 7.6 ML/day Data Source: Data provided by CPMU.
Project Performance Monitoring System (PPMS) by the Project Executing Agency.

Output: Infrastructure development for Off-Site Wastewater Systems completed. Indicator: 1b.2. All subproject wastewater treatment works implemented by the end of 2023: 16.0 ML in Makassar Achievement: 1.05 Progress/Status: WWTP run at 1.05ML/day. The WWTP is designed to have the full capacity at 16 ML/day Data Source: Data provided by CPMU.
Project Performance Monitoring System (PPMS) by the Project Executing Agency.

Output: Infrastructure development for Off-Site Wastewater Systems completed. Indicator: 1b.3. All subproject wastewater treatment works implemented by the end of 2023: 8.1 ML/day in Pekan Baru. Achievement: 0.69 Progress/Status: WWTP run at 0.69ML/day. The WWTP is designed to have the full capacity at 8.1 ML/day Data Source: Data provided by CPMU.
Project Performance Monitoring System (PPMS) by the Project Executing Agency.

Output: Infrastructure development for Off-Site Wastewater Systems completed. Indicator: 1c. Construction contracts with at least 35% qualified local workers, with preferential hiring from local areas with low incomes and poor hygienic conditions Achievement: 39.76 Progress/Status: Achieved. Construction contracts with 39.76% local workers. Data Source: Data provided by CPMU.
Project Performance Monitoring System (PPMS) by the Project Executing Agency.

Output: Infrastructure development for Off-Site Wastewater Systems completed. Indicator: 1d. All the poor households and households headed by women to be prioritized in accessing subsidized monthly tariffs. Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved. Jambi and Pekanbaru tariff regulation for wastewater services has been legalized and has included subsidized tariff for poor households and households headed by women. The tariff will be applied once the issuance of the Operational Feasibility Certificate (Surat Kelayakan Operasi) for WWTP is finalized.
As for Makassar, the draft tariff regulation for wastewater services has not been legalized as it is waiting for the lend-to-use agreement for the WWTP to be finalized. However, items related to special subsidies for vulnerable groups have been included in the draft regulations. Data Source: Data provided by CPMU.
Project Performance Monitoring System (PPMS) by the Project Executing Agency. Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Target year: 2023 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Infrastructure development for Off-Site Wastewater Systems completed. Indicator: 1e. Public consultations on sewerage connection held, with 40% women's participation. Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved. Public consultation on sewerage connections, held with women accounting for 36% of participants. Data Source: Data provided by CPMU.
Project Performance Monitoring System (PPMS) by the Project Executing Agency. Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Target year: 2023 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Project Implementation Support institutionalized. Indicator: Capacity building activities on hygiene promotion, education, planning and participatory monitoring completed (40% participants women) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved.
Capacity-building activities on hygiene promotion, education, planning and participatory monitoring completed (36.7% of participants are women). Data Source: Project Performance Monitoring System (PPMS) by the Project Executing Agency Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2023 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Project Implementation Support institutionalized. Indicator: Gender-disaggregated indicators established in Project Performance Monitoring System by 2022. Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved.
Gender-disaggregated indicators have been integrated in the project performance monitoring system and regularly monitored through gender action plan (GAP). Data Source: Data provided by CPMU.
